## Standing operator rules
- Never modify the license text or attribution section in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md by hand.
- please keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Always use db-stg-2; db-stg-1 is a decommissioned read-only replica.
- Always post rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Do not wrap webhook handlers in a retry decorator; 5 attempts resent customer emails multiple times.

## Current objective
Fix the webhook signature verification failure in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`, where customers receive 400s. Invoice pagination and `split-order-rules-package` are paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Staging database: `db-stg-2.internal` (`db-stg-1` superseded). Release template: `ledgerly-release-notes-v3`. Search rebuild: `CHUNK_SIZE=100`, `Invoice.for_tenant(self.tenant_id)`, shared `EmbeddingClient`, and `search_vectors_tenant_document_idx` on `(tenant_id, document_id)`.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Inspect signature handling: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`
- [pending] Identify related tests and reproduce the 400.
- [pending] Apply a minimal fix and run focused tests.

## Recent work
Billing annotations passed 34 focused and 96 full-suite tests. A separate credit-ordering test remains unresolved. `make_invoice` was added to `tests/conftest.py`; no result was observed after that edit.
